root_cause.text: The `do_procmap_query()` function in `fs/proc/task_mmu.c` incorrectly uses the `out` error-handling label when a build ID buffer size check fails, which triggers a duplicate `mmput()` call because the `mm_struct` reference has already been released earlier in the function.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that when the build ID size check fails (`karg.build_id_size < build_id_sz`), the jump target is changed from `goto out;` (which executes `mmput(mm)`) to `goto out_file;` (which bypasses `mmput(mm)` and only cleans up `vm_file` and `name_buf`).

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce a new error exit label to prevent null pointer dereferences or improper resource release during early failures in do_procmap_query.
intent_record.what: Added a new jump label 'out_file' in the error cleanup path of do_procmap_query, positioned after mmput and query_vma_teardown but before fput and kfree.
intent_record.how: Enables early error paths to bypass memory descriptor releasing and VMA teardown when those resources have not yet been initialized or acquired, while still ensuring file references and buffers are properly freed.
